_doc: Work-Tree schema reference. Two structures: index.json (tree root) and node files (nodes/<id>.json). All persisted paths must be relative to session root.

index.json.project: XX市智慧城市信息化项目

node.json (nodes/<id>.json).tender_text: 核心交换机上行带宽不低于10Gbps，需提供产品截图证明#
node.json (nodes/<id>.json).tender_location: 招标文件.pdf p.34 第3.1.3条

searched_paths.verdict: 仅产品手册，无测试报告

index.json.tender_file: Relative path to the tender file in session directory
index.json.target_doc: Relative path to the target document being written. Must never be absolute path. Set by document-writer Phase 2, consumed by all skills.
index.json.facts_ref: Optional relative path to facts file. Recommended value: .bid/facts.json
index.json.phase: Current phase: 需求分析 | 材料搜集 | 技术标撰写 | 商务标撰写 | 质量检查
index.json.summary: Aggregate counts by status, must stay in sync with children
index.json.current_focus: ID of the node currently being worked on, null if none
index.json.template_findings: Optional. Reported by bid-analysis when template-related content is discovered. { found: bool, type: 'embedded_chapter'|'standalone_file'|'scattered_description', location: string, structure_summary: string }
index.json.autopilot: Optional. Present when autopilot mode is active. { enabled: bool, current_stage: number, stages: [{ id: number, name: string, status: 'pending'|'in_progress'|'done', progress?: string }] }
index.json.registry_progress: Optional. Tracks batch material-registry construction progress. { total: number, indexed: number, current_batch: string, batch_order: string[] }

children[].title: Short title summarizing the requirement
children[].priority: star (★=废标) | hash (#=需截图) | dot (●=需演示) | triangle (▲=核心产品) | normal
children[].materials: Optional: { collected: N, total: M } progress of material collection
children[].node_ref: Relative path to the node detail file

node.json.id: Must match the id in index.json children
node.json.tender_location: File + page + clause reference for traceability
node.json.priority: Same as in index.json child entry
node.json.scoring: Scoring mechanism: 逐项扣减型 or 档次评分型, with details

materials[].name: Descriptive name of the material
materials[].source: Relative path to materials/<id>-<name>.md, null if not yet collected
materials[].key_facts: Optional: key facts extracted from the material
materials[].search_scope: Optional: directories within session root to search for this material
materials[].searched_paths: Array of { path, verdict, time } recording search attempts. path=directory searched, verdict=what was found/not found, time=which round. Survives context compression.

response.draft: Draft response text, null if not yet written
response.deviation: 正偏离 | 无偏离 | 负偏离, null if not yet determined

conventions.md._doc: Three-section structure. All nodes MUST read this file before writing.

sections.一、格式约定: Writing style rules: perspective, terminology, detail level, numbering conventions
sections.二、关键决策日志: Decisions that ALL subsequent nodes must follow. Table format: 决策ID | 决策内容 | 影响节点 | 决策依据 | 记录时间
sections.三、一致性检查点: Quick checklist before writing each node: 引用产品参数→查选型决策；提及响应时间→查承诺数值；提及金额→查报价表
